Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Our Belgian SAP BI & Data team is made up of a dynamic and passionate group of individuals. With a collective experience ranging from 2 to +20 years, our colleagues have dedicated a significant portion of their careers to Capgemini, showing how much we love it here. From database migrations to data warehouses and dynamic reporting, we take it upon ourselves to maximize data-potential and empower our customers to extract the most value from their data.

Your role

As a Data Migration Expert (SAP), you'll be at the forefront of designing and executing data migration strategies that ensure smooth and efficient transitions across systems. Your role will be pivotal in overseeing data migration projects, from initial planning through to execution and validation. You'll ensure that data is accurately and securely transferred between systems, maintaining integrity and consistency throughout the process. Utilizing advanced tools like SAP migration cockpit and EMIGALL, you’ll streamline migration workflows and resolve any challenges that arise. If you’re passionate about orchestrating complex data migrations and want to lead in a cutting-edge environment, this position is for you.

Key tasks & activities

• You act as an experienced data migration consultant on data migration and data governance projects. You engage in a diverse range of activities, including delivery planning, data gathering, data cleansing and validation, development, testing, and execution of the migration.
• You interact with clients during workshops and trainings, forming the key link between customer requirements and technical solutions.
• You lead the implementation team, offering guidance and training to junior members while ensuring strict adherence to the project plan.
• You work closely with your project manager and the project team, but also with functional colleagues to create the best solution possible. You act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
• 
You provide support in proposals, product developments, and further research around Data Solutions

 

Knowledge & Experience

• You have a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in executing (SAP) migration projects, showcasing extensive analytical skills and technical knowledge on end-to-end migration lifecycles.
• You have acquired skills within:
• Data analysis: ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and quality of the migrated data by cleansing, transforming and validating data. This requires the use of data analysis languages such as SQL, and data analysis tools such as MS Excel or Access.
• Data migration: planning, executing and managing the migration of data from legacy systems to new target environments. This involves ensuring seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading processes, which requires proficiency in data migration tools such as S/4HANA migration cockpit, Emigall and/or LSMW. Knowledge of ETL tools as SAP Data services or Datasphere is a plus.
• Data migration planning: Strong team management skills are necessary to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams, ensuring that all members are aligned with project goals and timelines. This includes delegating tasks appropriately, providing guidance and support, fostering a collaborative work environment, and managing stakeholder expectations.
• You possess knowledge on one or more of the main functional areas within a business, e.g., sales & distribution, purchasing, material management, financial management, and Human capital management.
• You are a proactive, results-driven team player with strong communication skills, a customer-oriented approach, and a consultancy mindset, capable of collaborating with diverse colleagues and confidently representing Capgemini to clients.
• Resident in Belgium.
• Fluent in Dutch/French and English.
• Geographic mobility. We serve customers throughout Belgium.

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!
 

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.
 

 
 

Position overview:
 

 
 

An Electrical & Auxillary Supervisor is responsible for leading a team of electrical and maintenance shop team members, managing the life cycle of all support equipment and electrical resources, including execution of maintenance, process improvement and contracting with outside services. This role ensures the reliable and efficient operation of all electrical systems and support equipment within the plant. This role leads a team of electricians and maintenance specialists that focuses on maximizing production throughput, minimizing downtime, and sustaining high equipment availability by leading maintenance activities, troubleshooting electrical and mechanical issues, and implementing proactive improvement strategies. The supervisor drives operational excellence while ensuring safety, compliance, and optimal resource utilization across the plant.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Maintain all electrical systems and auxiliary equipment to ensure high uptime, production throughput, and minimal downtime 

• Lead, coach, and develop electricians and maintenance specialists, ensuring a skilled, high-performing team 

• Plan, prioritize, and oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities 

• Ensure all work is performed safely and in compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and food safety standards 

• Identify and implement initiatives to improve equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness 

• Rapidly diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical problems to minimize production interruptions 

• Manage personnel, tools, materials, and external contractors effectively to meet operational goals 

• Maintain accurate maintenance logs, equipment records, SOPs, and performance metrics 

• Drive continuous improvement, ensuring optimal utilization of resources and alignment with plant objectives 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• Technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, support equipment, conveyance systems 

• Job related experience in an industrial environment with the focus on electrical, mechanical or maintenance role 

• Working knowledge of automation & controls 

• Ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex electrical and mechanical issues 

• Strong knowledge of plant electrical systems, auxiliary equipment, controls, and associated mechanical systems 

• Problem solving, trouble shooting and process improvement skills 

• Project management support for plant capital improvements, line speed alterations, conveyance changes and safety iniatives 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English 

• Leads, coaches, and develops a high-performing maintenance and electrical team  

 
 

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. When you join Ball you belong to a team of over 16,000 members worldwide. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles solutions that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.
 

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.
 

Please note the advertised job title might vary from the job title on the contract due to local job title structure and global HR systems. 
 

No agencies please.

As a Software Engineer (with .Net seniority) you actively participate in the various steps of the development process: analysis, architecture, design, implementation, testing, documentation, and maintenance. You work in a self-organized cross-functional Development Team in an Agile and fast-paced dynamic environment.
Role
• Analyze and review product requirements, and discuss the technical feasibility
• Build technical design proposals
• Develop new software components or modify existing ones
• Participate in peer code reviews
• Plan, define and perform unit testing
• Create or maintain technical documentation
• Integrate individual software components developed by yourself and other members of the development team
• Solve defects reported in the defect tracking system
• Maintain existing applications
• Identify risks and discuss them with the Quality Control department for building adequate test plans
• Make work estimates for the tasks assigned to you
• Plan, track and report your daily work and your assigned tasks to your direct manager
• Follow the software development process (Source Control Management, Defect Tracking, Coding Rules, Continuous Integration)
• Identify and propose process improvements
• Coach and guide junior team members

• Knowledge or experience in Object-Oriented Design and Programming
• Advanced knowledge in .NET and especially .NET Core
• Understanding of the full software life cycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, and maintenance
• Experience with CI/CD software is a plus (preferably TeamCity)
• Experience in Agile Application Development & Scrum methodologies is a plus
• Engineer, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science (high school or university)
• 5 years of experience in a similar position
Soft skills:

• Focus on quality, detail-minded, willing to take care of customer point of view
• Critical but constructive mindset focused on delivery constraints and pragmatism
• Open for changes and continuous learning
• Shows initiative, is curious, and communicates well about initiatives
• Good written and verbal communication skills share information actively; respond properly, reports on time; accept criticism and other opinions, addresses criticism constructively
• Excellent team player
• Stress resistance; does not give up in crisis situation; does not lose control under pressure
• Aligned with company values : Innovation, Passion, Excellence, Agility, Accountability, Teamwork, and Customer Success
Languages:
